brief:
Israeli forces have pushed their armored vehicles beyond the "Yellow Line"—a demarcation point in Gaza—triggering a new wave of Palestinian displacement, Al Jazeera English reported. The advance marks an expansion of Israel's ground operations in the territory, where hundreds of thousands of Palestinians have already been displaced since October 2023.

The movement of tanks into new territory signals an intensification of military operations and raises questions about the trajectory of the conflict and humanitarian conditions for civilians caught in the fighting.
dek: Israeli tanks advance beyond the 'Yellow Line', forcing Palestinians to flee again in Gaza.
title: Israeli tanks advance beyond Yellow Line in Gaza
